name: Where Gods Rot
source:
You're in a dark room with no knowledge as to how you got there. 

The only thing you can see is a chained up man, who is very insistent about being set free. 

Would it be a good idea to do as he asks?

[from [url=https://nightmareweaverz.itch.io/where-gods-rot]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个黑暗的房间里，不知道自己是如何到达那里的。

你唯一能看到的是一个被锁链锁着的人，他非常坚持要被释放。

按照他的要求去做是个好主意吗？

[来自[url=https://nightmareweaverz.itch.io/where-gods-rot]Itch.io[/url]]
